review_notes: The archived HTML was read from object storage; this check made no network requests and wrote no database rows.
Source point-state rows were compared with parser point states game by game; active server markers and tie-break winner markers were independently read from the source DOM.

The v3 persisted output was wrong for server side: UXYqpB76 has a source-highlighted home server in its first game, while all 40 parsed point records in that document say side 1. MZ1H6Phf and fVArlUH0 show the same all-side-1 v3 pattern. v4 output is not yet deployed or replayed into the database.
Ten of the 30 latest linked archives have no recognized point rows. They remain documented coverage gaps, not parser passes.
